issues_addressed.claim: PlayOn violated the CCPA's prohibition on selling or sharing personal information of consumers aged 13-16 without affirmative opt-in consent
issues_addressed.action_taken: Revised to clarify that the settlement requires future compliance with minor-specific protections, but the CPPA decision did not make a specific finding that PlayOn violated these provisions. Added Loeb & Loeb citation corroborating this distinction. Removed [DISPUTED] tag from section heading.

issues_addressed.claim: PlayOn's privacy notice had not been updated for over a year
issues_addressed.action_taken: Revised to specify that the privacy notice had not been updated since July 2022 — over two and a half years — accurately reflecting the duration reported by WilmerHale, Holland & Knight, and Inside Privacy. Removed [DISPUTED] tag from section heading.

issues_addressed.claim: the CPPA ruled this does not satisfy CCPA requirements under Cal. Civ. Code Section 1798.120
issues_addressed.action_taken: Updated to reference both Section 1798.120 (consumer right to opt out) and Section 1798.135 (business obligation to provide opt-out mechanisms) with correct URLs for each. Added Section 1798.120 to Sources list.
